warning: Platform limits and laws change. Re-check items older than 6 months on dev.wildberries.ru, docs.ozon.ru and consultant.ru before relying on them.

wb.rate_limit: 1 request/second shared by all Feedbacks and Questions methods per seller; >3 rps blocks for 60 s; 409 counts as 5 requests
wb.token: valid 180 days; separate categories: Feedbacks and Questions, Buyers Chat, Buyers Returns; can be read-only

review_answer.edit: no edit method: delete and create again

chat_message.window: FBO: within 48 h of the buyer's last message; FBS/rFBS: after payment and within 72 h after delivery, then replies only within 48 h

ozon.rate_limit: 50 requests/second per Client-Id unless a method sets its own; honour Retry-After on 429

forbidden_in_public_answers: phone numbers, e-mails, messenger handles, links (except the platform's own pages)
naming other marketplaces or inviting to buy elsewhere
asking to change, delete or raise a rating; rewards for reviews
promising refunds, compensation, delivery dates or returns that the platform or a human has not confirmed
insults, sarcasm, blaming the buyer, veiled threats
the buyer's personal data or order details
medical or cure claims, guaranteed results, dosage advice
product facts given from memory: only from the card, documents or the brand fact sheet
blaming the marketplace warehouse or delivery service in public

law.remote_refusal: ЗоЗПП ст. 26.1 п. 4: before delivery and within 7 days after it; 3 months if written return information was not given at delivery; refund within 10 days of the demand, minus the seller's return shipping costs; not for individually defined goods
law.return_method: КС РФ Постановление 7-П от 17.02.2026: until the law is amended the buyer may return remotely bought goods by any method that lets the seller inspect them on receipt; the buyer bears transit risk and costs
law.defects: ЗоЗПП ст. 18: replacement, price reduction, repair, refund; technically complex goods: refund/replacement within 15 days of transfer, later only for a substantial defect, missed repair deadline, or >30 days unusable per warranty year
law.deadlines: ст. 22: price reduction / refund / repair costs within 10 days of the demand; ст. 20: repair within the agreed term, max 45 days; ст. 21: replacement within 7 days (20 if a check is needed)
law.exchange: ст. 25: proper-quality non-food goods exchanged within 14 days not counting the purchase day, if unused with tags and receipt; refund within 3 days if no analogue
law.rules_of_sale: Постановление Правительства № 657 от 30.05.2026, in force from 01.09.2026 (replaced № 2463): non-exchangeable list, remote-sale exclusions (п. 30), packaging and completeness for remote returns (п. 44), covers aggregator owners
law.technically_complex_list: Постановление Правительства № 924 от 10.11.2011 (status after 01.09.2026 to be re-checked)
